---
name: Bug report
about: Tell us what went wrong and what you expected Notes to do.
---

Reports are public. Do not include private notes, passwords, tokens or sign-in
links. Use a made-up example if note text is needed. Check any screenshot for
private information before attaching it.

## Device

Phone, tablet or computer? Which model and operating system/version?

## Browser

Browser name and version, if known. Was Notes in a browser tab or opened from
the home-screen icon?

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open Notes and ...
2. ...

## Expected result

What did you expect to happen?

## Actual result

What happened instead? Include the visible error message, with any private
details removed. Does it happen every time or only sometimes?
